note: Source of truth for the Arcade Fixes cockpit's CONTENT-QUALITY / fix dimension. Each entry is a shipped, gated (Nancy + Chris, Karl where facts asserted) content-quality fix to an arcade game listed in games.html. The functional/render dimension is generated separately by arcade-audit.mjs (headless load test). arcade-audit.mjs merges this ledger + scores.json into arcade-health.json so the cockpit reflects fixes. Append new fixes via _tools/arcade-fixes/record-fix.sh (called in the per-game ship sequence, after record-chris-pass.sh).
